equations: declared household, hospital, enterprise, infrastructure, and ecology submodel equations
typed inter-domain exchange and boundary equations
separate service, burden, cost, provenance, settlement, and institutional ledgers
authority_sources: all independently accepted SD-01 through SD-13 authorities/results applicable to the integrated model
implementation_interfaces: future independently accepted integrated model adapters
future domain boundary and exchange adapters
future accepted oracle, DAG, cache, receipt, and checkpoint harnesses

model_domain.model: five declared coupled synthetic domains with explicit exchange, dependency, and institutional layers
model_domain.domain_authority: each domain owns its dynamics/topology; separate integrated authority owns cross-domain exchange and institutional rules
state: complete typed state of all five domains
model_domain.dependency_topology_authority: composite of exact domain-owned topologies plus separately authorized typed cross-domain edges
model_domain.boundary: open complete-model control volume; every external flow, information source, intervention, and institution is explicit

initial_conditions: one sealed, unit-checked initial state per scenario/institution cell derived prospectively from accepted component domains
parameters: 5 coupled domain components per run: 64 household agents, 16 hospital units, 32 enterprise agents, 64 infrastructure vertices with 128 edges, and 32 ecology stocks

5 scenario stress families while all domains remain present: household demand +1/4 on days 90..119; hospital demand +1/2 on days 90..119; enterprise capacity -1/4 on days 90..119; first four canonical infrastructure edges unavailable days 90..119; ecology regeneration rho -1/4 on days 90..119
6 institutional configurations: throughput/no institutional feedback; reserve-first; equal-access; need-priority; protected-disclosure-with-appeal; integrated correction-and-settlement

12 typed cross-domain exchange edges evaluated once per day in canonical order: household labor->enterprise; enterprise goods->household; household demand->infrastructure; infrastructure service->household; household demand->hospital; hospital service->household; enterprise supply->hospital; hospital recovery->household labor; ecology resource->enterprise; ecology resource->infrastructure; infrastructure service->hospital; enterprise maintenance->infrastructure
32 fixed seeds
all cross-domain parameters frozen before any run
comparators: coupled physical/service model without institutional feedback
coupled model with each registered institutional configuration
positive_controls: zero cross-domain exchange reproduces independent domain totals
balanced internal exchange cancels once at composite level
certified repeated motif/canonical component reproduces cold computation exactly
negative_controls: unowned external inflow or hidden loss fails closure
same cross-domain benefit counted in both domains refuses
institutional optimum inferred from physical optimum refuses
failed prerequisite study prevents positive integrated interpretation
configuration.seeds: exact integers 0..31 paired across comparable coupled/institutional cells
configuration.stochastic_rules: EBU-STAGE-F-COUNTER-HASH-DRAWS-v1; streams are HOUSEHOLD_EVENT, HOSPITAL_EVENT, ENTERPRISE_EVENT, INFRASTRUCTURE_EVENT, ECOLOGY_EVENT, CROSS_DOMAIN_EVENT in that canonical order; each domain uses the exact already-frozen rule of its prospectively selected predecessor configuration, selected by fixed configuration label rather than outcome; analysis draws, outcome-dependent resampling, and every other stream are forbidden
configuration.uncertainty_rules: REGISTERED-SEED-SUMMARY-01 and NUMERICAL-POLICY-01: every seed and paired difference in ascending seed order, exact even-sample median, and separate domain/integrated closed min/max registered-seed ranges; bootstrap, confidence/population intervals, resampling, and empirical/population inference are forbidden
stopping_rules: stop/retain on unit, topology, conservation, receipt, or provenance failure
retain modeled collapse or institutional failure as registered outcome
resource cap is inconclusive
do not run if any required predecessor disposition/authority identity is absent

computational_feasibility.algorithmic_cost_class: O(R*H*(sum domain update costs+V+E)) plus exact registered interaction costs; no universal integrated complexity claim
computational_feasibility.exact_problem_size: five domain updates and 12 cross-domain exchange evaluations per day; 5 scenario families * 6 institutional configurations * 32 seeds = 960 runs
computational_feasibility.subset_or_hyperedge_order: declared cross-domain hyperedges <=4; any exact Boolean decomposition obeys n<=18 and MOBIUS-EXACT-01
computational_feasibility.future_measurement_method: per-domain transition, exchange, DAG, subset, receipt, cache, wall/RSS, trace, and output counters
computational_feasibility.checkpoint_restart_scheme: checkpoint every 30 ticks with complete domain, stochastic, delay/memory, receipt, cache epoch, and provenance state; exact suffix equality
computational_feasibility.parallelization_boundary: runs/seeds may be parallel with fixed streams; within-run domain order and cross-domain settlement order are canonical
computational_feasibility.timeout_or_resource_disposition: REFUSED_BEFORE_EXECUTION or COMPUTATIONALLY_INCONCLUSIVE; no domain removal, topology alteration, truncation, sampling, or approximation substitution

falsifiers: any missing or failed required predecessor authority/control
interaction, correction, cache, or settlement double count
model result promoted to empirical or universal claim

ledgers: each domain physical and represented state
conservation_accounting.no_double_count_rule: each internal cross-domain flow cancels once at composite level, every joint effect has one declared allocation, and institutional transfers never create physical stock

acceptance: all 960 cells and seeds visible
all predecessor identities and exact controls pass
all domain and composite ledgers reconcile without double count
claims stay model-, scenario-, institution-, horizon-, and evidence-specific
inconclusive: failed checkpoint, provenance, oracle, DAG, or cache identity
unresolved cross-domain boundary or unit semantics
studies.independent_result_audit: reconstruct every domain and composite ledger from immutable traces, verify paired seeds and all exact controls/certificates/receipts, compare isolated/coupled baselines, and audit every claim boundary before Part IX
book_destination: Part IX last: complete-economy scenarios and bounded institutional interpretation
prohibited_interpretations: synthetic complete economy as empirical economy
failed/inconclusive prerequisite hidden by aggregate outcome
